exposure: Intrathecal morphine and fentanyl with acetaminophen and NSAIDs
Intrathecal fentanyl with systemic acetaminophen and NSAIDs
Risk factors for poorer analgesic results
outcome: Severity of postoperative pain at rest
Severity of postoperative pain with movement
cohort: The study included 514 women undergoing elective caesarean section.
finding: The combination of intrathecal morphine and fentanyl with acetaminophen and Non Steroid Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) was associated with better pain control post-caesarean section compared to other analgesic strategies.
